label: negative
rationale_zh: 本次提交修正强调（emph/strong）节点的源码位置：S_insert_emph() 在部分消耗分隔符时调整 opener/closer 文本节点以及新建 emph 节点的 start_column / end_column，即改变了公开接口 cmark_node_get_start_column() / cmark_node_get_end_column() 以及 CMARK_OPT_SOURCEPOS 输出所返回的值（api 语义变化，api_test 随之更新期望值）。看上去像是“公开 API 返回值语义变了、harness 可能需要跟进”，但 harness 并不断言源码位置，只是在由输入选择的选项（含 SOURCEPOS）下解析并调用全部渲染器（含输出 sourcepos 属性的 XML 渲染器）；改动行位于普通强调解析路径上，在定额 fuzz 的多个种子中都被执行，且无新崩溃。harness 无需任何修改，属于隐式 api 阴性。
rationale_en: This commit fixes the source positions of emphasis nodes: when delimiters are partially consumed, S_insert_emph() now adjusts start_column / end_column of the opener/closer text nodes and of the new emph node, i.e. it changes the values returned by the public cmark_node_get_start_column() / cmark_node_get_end_column() and emitted under CMARK_OPT_SOURCEPOS (an API-semantics change; api_test expectations were updated). It looks like 'a public API's return values changed, the harness may need to follow', but the harness asserts nothing about positions: it parses under input-selected options (SOURCEPOS included) and runs every renderer (including the XML renderer, which prints sourcepos attributes). The changed lines are on the ordinary emphasis-parsing path, executed in several seeds of the budgeted fuzz campaign with no new crash. No harness change is needed: a silent api negative.
